verdict.rationale:
Conductor's core design supports running many parallel agent tasks/workspaces simultaneously, each isolated (docs-1, docs-2), plus a programmatic API and MCP server to manage cloud workspaces at scale (docs-13, docs-14), and 'routines' to trigger agents on schedules or via GitHub Actions across many tasks (docs-4). Community confirms real-world parallel usage and requests for even broader bulk scope (multi-repo tasks) that isn't yet supported (conductor-comm-12), which is a real gap rather than a contradiction of the core capability.
missing for 10: evidence of true multi-repo bulk operations, and independent benchmarking of how many parallel items it can realistically handle.
